native_controls.scope: Unchanged original search/helper definitions with synthetic predicate costs and exhaustive subset oracle. Does not qualify default2500 budget or learned predicate coverage.

findings: Branch-and-bound finite5-predicate search agrees with exhaustive subset minimum-cost oracle when given10000 calls; default2500 search and scale remain unqualified.
Training lowers target coverage to coverable training pairs when requested recall is unreachable; requested training recall is not a guarantee of dataset-wide completeness.
Learner samples up to50000 indexed records and10000 candidate pairs with hardcoded defaults in this version.
Active-learning bootstrap marks repeated self-pair positive and random pair negative; no dataset truth validation inferred.
limits: Original upstream training/labeler tests read but not run.
No learned-model, large-data performance or full-package gate.
